title: 電網儲能電池管理系統
subcategoryTitle: 電池儲能電站與電池系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Battery storage plants and battery systems
summary: 電池管理系統量測每一顆電芯的電壓與溫度，估計還剩多少電、還有多少壽命，讓各電芯保持均衡，並在任何一顆越界時切斷電路；它是電池的大腦，也是最後一道電子防線。澳洲的維多利亞大電池在 2021 年試運轉時起火，原因之一就是那個機櫃的監控正好處於離線狀態。課程定量分析電壓誤差對荷電狀態的影響、被動均衡的時間、資料量、過充保護的時間餘裕與監控空窗。
summaryEn: A battery management system measures voltage and temperature of every cell, estimates charge and life remaining, keeps cells balanced and opens the circuit when any goes out of bounds; it is the battery's brain and last electronic defence. The Victorian Big Battery in Australia caught fire during commissioning in 2021, one cause being that monitoring of that cabinet happened to be offline. The course quantifies the effect of voltage error on state of charge, passive balancing time, data volume, margin for overcharge protection and monitoring gaps.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：電網儲能電池管理系統
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Grid Storage Battery Management Systems
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「功率、能量與時長」與「量測資料量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Power, energy and duration" and "Volume of measurement data": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Power, energy and duration" is correct?
options: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。
儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。
資料收集得越多，電站就越安全。
optionsEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration.
The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating.
The more data collected, the safer the plant.
quiz.explanation: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「功率、能量與時長」如何決定「電網儲能電池管理系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power, energy and duration” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Grid Storage Battery Management Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。調頻用的系統時長可能只有半小時到一小時，移轉太陽能尖峰的系統則為四小時或更長。功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：規模為 300 MW／450 MWh，2021 年 12 月啟用
steps.observationEn: Project file: It is 300 MW and 450 MWh, opened in December 2021
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「功率、能量與時長」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Power, energy and duration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency.

knowledge.text: 誤解：儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 依「功率、能量與時長」的模型 t = E / P，額定功率下的放電時長最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = E / P for "Power, energy and duration", which value is closest to the discharge duration at rated power?
quiz.explanation: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 450 MWh、Pb = 300 MW，得 1.50 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 450 MWh, Pb = 300 MW the result is 1.50 h (discharge duration at rated power). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「功率、能量與時長」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Power, energy and duration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = E / P；代入 Eb = 450 MWh、Pb = 300 MW，得 1.50 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Pb 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = E / P; with Eb = 450 MWh, Pb = 300 MW the result is 1.50 h (discharge duration at rated power). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Pb by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.36 h（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 1.36 h (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1.50 h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Pb 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1.50 h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Pb with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 450 MWh、Pb = 300 MW，得 1.50 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。
knowledge.textEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 450 MWh, Pb = 300 MW the result is 1.50 h (discharge duration at rated power).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.36 h（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 1.36 h (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Power, energy and duration"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
電池只要不常使用，就可以保存很久而不衰退。
依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A battery that is seldom used keeps its capacity for a very long time.

Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.
quiz.explanation: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「功率、能量與時長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Power, energy and duration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要同時載明交流側可用能量、額定功率、量測點與壽期末保證值，避免直流標稱值與交流可用值混淆。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specifications should state usable AC energy, rated power, measurement point and end-of-life guarantee together, to avoid confusing nominal DC with usable AC values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Grid Storage Battery Management Systems”.

steps.titleEn: Volume of measurement data: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「量測資料量」如何決定「電網儲能電池管理系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Volume of measurement data” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Grid Storage Battery Management Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 一座四百五十 MWh 的電站裡有五十萬顆左右的電芯。管理系統分成三層：最底層的電路板每秒量測十幾到幾十顆電芯的電壓與溫度；中間層彙整一整個電池架的資料並控制接觸器；最上層管理整座電站並與調度中心通訊。每顆電芯每秒一筆、每筆兩個位元組，一天就是將近九十 GB 的原始資料。這些資料如果只是存著，就毫無用處；它的價值在於從中找出那一顆開始偏離常軌的電芯——在它出事之前幾天甚至幾週。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A 450 MWh plant has about half a million cells. The management system has three levels: boards at the bottom measure voltage and temperature of a dozen to dozens of cells each second; the middle level gathers a whole rack's data and controls contactors; the top manages the plant and talks to dispatch. One reading per cell per second at two bytes each is nearly ninety gigabytes of raw data a day. Merely stored, it is useless; its worth lies in finding the one cell beginning to stray, days or weeks before it fails. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：由 212 個電池機櫃組成
steps.observationEn: Project file: It consists of 212 battery cabinets
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「資料收集得越多，電站就越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more data collected, the safer the plant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「量測資料量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Volume of measurement data”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 一座四百五十 MWh 的電站裡有五十萬顆左右的電芯。管理系統分成三層：最底層的電路板每秒量測十幾到幾十顆電芯的電壓與溫度；中間層彙整一整個電池架的資料並控制接觸器；最上層管理整座電站並與調度中心通訊。每顆電芯每秒一筆、每筆兩個位元組，一天就是將近九十 GB 的原始資料。這些資料如果只是存著，就毫無用處；它的價值在於從中找出那一顆開始偏離常軌的電芯——在它出事之前幾天甚至幾週。
knowledge.textEn: A 450 MWh plant has about half a million cells. The management system has three levels: boards at the bottom measure voltage and temperature of a dozen to dozens of cells each second; the middle level gathers a whole rack's data and controls contactors; the top manages the plant and talks to dispatch. One reading per cell per second at two bytes each is nearly ninety gigabytes of raw data a day. Merely stored, it is useless; its worth lies in finding the one cell beginning to stray, days or weeks before it fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：資料收集得越多，電站就越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 依「量測資料量」的模型 D = N·f·b·86400，502,000 顆電芯、每秒取樣 1 次、每筆 2 位元組時每天的資料量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model D = N·f·b·86400 for "Volume of measurement data", which value is closest to the data a day for 502,000 cells sampled once a second at 2 bytes a reading?
options: 87 GB/d
867 GB/d
optionsEn: 87 GB/d
867 GB/d
quiz.explanation: D = N·f·b·86400；代入 N = 502000、f = 1 Hz、b = 2 B，得 87 GB/d（502,000 顆電芯、每秒取樣 1 次、每筆 2 位元組時每天的資料量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: D = N·f·b·86400; with N = 502000, f = 1 Hz, b = 2 B the result is 87 GB/d (data a day for 502,000 cells sampled once a second at 2 bytes a reading). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 量測資料量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Volume of measurement data: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「量測資料量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Volume of measurement data” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：D = N·f·b·86400；代入 N = 502000、f = 1 Hz、b = 2 B，得 87 GB/d（502,000 顆電芯、每秒取樣 1 次、每筆 2 位元組時每天的資料量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 f 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: D = N·f·b·86400; with N = 502000, f = 1 Hz, b = 2 B the result is 87 GB/d (data a day for 502,000 cells sampled once a second at 2 bytes a reading). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise f by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：f 增加 10% 時，結果變為 95 GB/d（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising f by 10% changes the result to 95 GB/d (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 87 GB/d（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 f 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 87 GB/d (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in f with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: D = N·f·b·86400；代入 N = 502000、f = 1 Hz、b = 2 B，得 87 GB/d（502,000 顆電芯、每秒取樣 1 次、每筆 2 位元組時每天的資料量）。
knowledge.textEn: D = N·f·b·86400; with N = 502000, f = 1 Hz, b = 2 B the result is 87 GB/d (data a day for 502,000 cells sampled once a second at 2 bytes a reading).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: f 增加 10% 時，結果變為 95 GB/d（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising f by 10% changes the result to 95 GB/d (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「量測資料量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Volume of measurement data"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以注入已知異常的歷史資料測試分析演算法，量測它偵測到異常電芯的提前時間與誤報率。
電池充滿了就會自己停止充電。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Historical data with known anomalies injected test analysis algorithms for lead time in detecting faulty cells and false-alarm rate.
A battery stops charging by itself when full.
quiz.explanation: 以注入已知異常的歷史資料測試分析演算法，量測它偵測到異常電芯的提前時間與誤報率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Historical data with known anomalies injected test analysis algorithms for lead time in detecting faulty cells and false-alarm rate. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 量測資料量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Volume of measurement data: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「量測資料量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Volume of measurement data” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以注入已知異常的歷史資料測試分析演算法，量測它偵測到異常電芯的提前時間與誤報率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Historical data with known anomalies injected test analysis algorithms for lead time in detecting faulty cells and false-alarm rate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監控系統要保留逐顆電芯的資料並以自動分析找出離群者，警報分級須能讓運轉人員據以行動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep cell-by-cell data and find outliers by automatic analysis, with alarms graded so operators can act on them.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了節省儲存與通訊而只保留平均值與極值時，個別電芯緩慢發展的異常趨勢被淹沒而無法事後追查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Keeping only means and extremes to save storage and bandwidth buries slowly developing anomalies of single cells beyond later tracing. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以注入已知異常的歷史資料測試分析演算法，量測它偵測到異常電芯的提前時間與誤報率。
knowledge.textEn: Historical data with known anomalies injected test analysis algorithms for lead time in detecting faulty cells and false-alarm rate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監控系統要保留逐顆電芯的資料並以自動分析找出離群者，警報分級須能讓運轉人員據以行動。
knowledge.textEn: Keep cell-by-cell data and find outliers by automatic analysis, with alarms graded so operators can act on them.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：UL 9540 儲能系統與設備／UL 9540A 熱失控延燒試驗方法。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: UL 9540 Energy Storage Systems and Equipment / UL 9540A thermal-runaway fire-propagation test method. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「量測資料量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Volume of measurement data" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
量一下電壓，就知道電池還剩多少電。
為了節省儲存與通訊而只保留平均值與極值時，個別電芯緩慢發展的異常趨勢被淹沒而無法事後追查。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Measuring voltage tells how much charge a battery has left.
Keeping only means and extremes to save storage and bandwidth buries slowly developing anomalies of single cells beyond later tracing.
quiz.explanation: 為了節省儲存與通訊而只保留平均值與極值時，個別電芯緩慢發展的異常趨勢被淹沒而無法事後追查。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Keeping only means and extremes to save storage and bandwidth buries slowly developing anomalies of single cells beyond later tracing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 量測資料量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Volume of measurement data: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「量測資料量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Volume of measurement data” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了節省儲存與通訊而只保留平均值與極值時，個別電芯緩慢發展的異常趨勢被淹沒而無法事後追查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「電網儲能電池管理系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Keeping only means and extremes to save storage and bandwidth buries slowly developing anomalies of single cells beyond later tracing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Grid Storage Battery Management Systems”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些資料如果只是存著，就毫無用處；它的價值在於從中找出那一顆開始偏離常軌的電芯——在它出事之前幾天甚至幾週。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Merely stored, it is useless; its worth lies in finding the one cell beginning to stray, days or weeks before it fails.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「資料收集得越多，電站就越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more data collected, the safer the plant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了節省儲存與通訊而只保留平均值與極值時，個別電芯緩慢發展的異常趨勢被淹沒而無法事後追查。
knowledge.textEn: Keeping only means and extremes to save storage and bandwidth buries slowly developing anomalies of single cells beyond later tracing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
